_about: The test builds made from the source that runs at the public program ids (proposals 3 to 6: the tree of v0.3.14, commit 6eb81dd), by sha256 of the file. A fixture of tests/fixtures whose sha256 is another one is a build of source that is not live yet: the programs for which that is so are what the next proposal set changes (tests/test_deploy_v2.py holds the release's list to it). `kept` is a copy of the live test build, under tests/fixtures: scripts/exercise_public.py rehearse --rc --simulate funds an order on it before it upgrades in place.
